verdict.rationale: Canny documents a broad native integration directory. It covers Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp and Asana with issue linking and status sync, plus Discord notifications, Fathom/Fireflies transcript capture, and Gong, Intercom and Slack feedback capture. The 'just a few clicks' setup is only evidenced for the MCP server ('secure sign-in. No API keys, no engineering'), not for the integrations generally, and Jira support is limited to Jira Cloud. missing for 10: documented click-through/OAuth setup flow for the native integrations, evidence of setup effort for tools beyond MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration of ease of connection.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect common third-party tools to my feedback workspace in just a few clicks

citations.quote: Native integrations keep the rest of your stack in sync.
Automatically capture feedback from Gong, Intercom, Slack, and dozens of other sources
Send feedback to Jira, link it to existing issues, and sync statuses. Only for Jira Cloud.
Send feedback to Linear, link it to existing issues, and sync statuses.
Add Canny's MCP server to ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor with a secure sign-in. No API keys, no engineering.
